title: Validated gas-phase conformational characterization of α-iminonitrile 2d
difficulty_reasons: The molecule and observables are fixed, but multiple starting conformers must be generated, optimized, deduplicated and frequency-validated.
The Agent must test a qualitative conformational hypothesis and separate gas-phase evidence from crystal comparison.

paper.title: Naphthyl--iminonitriles: Synthesis, characterization, and antibacterial drug potential

data.description: Self-contained identity, stereochemistry, charge, multiplicity and gas-phase boundary for compound 2d.

required_deliverables.description: Validated candidate conformations, selected minimum, dihedrals, energy, frequency check, method and conclusion.
